notes.title: Chapter Unlock Repair
notes.notes: Now that you have reached the position, you can unlock the chapter button on the main interface.

notes.title: Fix missing bug in archive
notes.notes:
Starting the game without correctly creating a save resulted in a bunch of spawning bugs, and now the save can be created normally.

Due to the current adjustment of the archive, the main interface jump off button cannot be unlocked temporarily after reaching the position in Chapter 2 and Chapter 3. You can choose to clear the level with one life or wait for 3 days to fix it.
